transcript: Speaker A: अभी SpeakEasy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: English बोलने में डर लगता है? गलत बोल देंगे इस डर से चिंता होती है? [Scared of speaking English? Worried you'll speak incorrectly?] तो Try करें SpeakEasy App! [Then try SpeakEasy App!] यहाँ आप अपनी personal AI coach, Vani के साथ जब चाहें तब English में बात कर सकते हैं। [Here you can talk in English with your personal AI coach, Vani, whenever you want.] Vani आपकी गलतियों को बिना judge किए तुरंत सुधारती है। [Vani corrects your mistakes instantly without judging.] आप interview, travel, या daily conversations जैसे real-life scenarios की practice कर सकते हैं। [You can practice real-life scenarios like interviews, travel, or daily conversations.] Vani के साथ daily practice से आप अपनी English धीरे-धीरे बिल्कुल fluent बना सकते हैं। [With daily practice with Vani, you can gradually make your English completely fluent.] सिर्फ ₹1 में अपना trial शुरू करें! आज ही SpeakEasy Download करें! [Start your trial for just ₹1! Download SpeakEasy today!] Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy AI. Install Now.
summary: The ad addresses the fear of making mistakes while speaking English, offering SpeakEasy's AI coach, Vani, as a non-judgmental practice partner. It highlights features like real-life scenario practice and instant corrections to build fluency. The call to action promotes a 1-rupee trial and directs users to download the app.
